ජාතික කාලගුණ විදයා මධයස්ථානයේ, අනාවැකි අංශෙ මගින් නිකුත්ත කරන ලදි

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 06 March 2026.
Mainly dry weather will prevail over the island.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Northern, North-central, Central,
Sabaragamuwa, Uva and North-western provinces during the early hours of the morning.
